content: The app keeps crashing every time I open it after the latest update. Please fix this problem.
My phone says the app is not working and it won't open. I tried reinstalling but the issue is still there.
I can't log in to my account anymore. It keeps saying something went wrong, please fix it.
After the update all my tasks disappeared. This is a serious problem and nobody is fixing it.
The app freezes on my phone every few minutes and then closes by itself.
Most features are locked behind the premium subscription. You have to pay every year, which is a cash grab.
Too expensive for what it offers. The free version is almost useless without paying for premium.
I was happy with the free version for years, but now they want a monthly subscription for basic things.
The premium plan is worth the price. The extra features really help me stay organized.
Fair price for the subscription and the free version is already enough for me.
The reminders work perfectly. I get a notification every day on time and it helps me build a daily habit.
Notifications are always on time and the daily reminder keeps me on track with my habits.
The alarm doesn't ring and the notification doesn't show up on time. Reminders don't work as they should.
I never get my reminder notification anymore. I missed several important tasks because of this.
Easy to add tasks and organize my list. The simple layout makes managing my to-do list effortless.
Simple and clean list app. Adding items and notes is quick and I can sort everything the way I like.
It does the basic list and note features, but nothing more than other to-do apps like Wunderlist or Microsoft To Do.
I would like to see more options for organizing my list, like folders or tags for items.
Google Calendar sync works great. All my events and tasks show up in the calendar view.
Sync with my Google calendar stopped working. Events are missing and tasks don't show in the calendar anymore.
The calendar view is useful, but sync sometimes takes a long time to update my events.
The new update changed the home screen widget layout. It is fine, though I miss the old version.
After the update the widget is broken and the screen looks worse than the previous version.
Love the new widget, it fits nicely on my home screen and shows my tasks at a glance.
The reminders are great, but the premium subscription is way too expensive for what it offers.
Good calendar sync, but the app crashes whenever I try to edit a recurring event.
It's okay. Does what I need but nothing special.
Average app. Some things work well and some things don't.
Not bad, but not great either. I use it sometimes.
